interactions.label: Gunfire
interactions.description: A kick with every shot. Shotguns, snipers and revolvers hit harder than SMGs.

interactions.label: Getting hit
interactions.description: Follows how much health the hit took.

interactions.label: Low health
interactions.description: Below 40% health. Gets stronger and faster the closer you are to flatlining.

interactions.label: Explosions
interactions.description: Grenades, cars and barrels within 30 m. The closer the blast, the stronger it is.

interactions.label: Melee swings
interactions.description: Each swing of a blade, blunt weapon, fists or arm cyberware.

interactions.label: Enemy down
interactions.description: When you kill or knock out an enemy.

interactions.label: Grabs & takedowns
interactions.description: Grabbing an enemy, takedowns and finishers.

interactions.label: Combat starts
interactions.description: Enemies spot you and a fight begins.

interactions.label: Charging up
interactions.description: Tech weapons and held melee attacks, building over 1.5 s. A charged shot kicks harder.

interactions.label: Reloads
interactions.description: A click when you start reloading.

interactions.label: Weapon overheat
interactions.description: When a weapon overheats and locks up.

interactions.label: Blocks & parries
interactions.description: Blocking a hit. A well-timed parry or a deflected bullet hits harder.

interactions.label: Grenade throws
interactions.description: Throwing a grenade or other combat gadget.

interactions.label: Hits landed
interactions.description: Every time you damage something. Busy with fast weapons.

interactions.label: Burning
interactions.description: While you are on fire.

interactions.label: Electrocuted & EMP
interactions.description: While you are being shocked or hit by an EMP.

interactions.label: Poisoned & bleeding
interactions.description: While poison or bleeding is draining your health.

interactions.label: Knocked down & stunned
interactions.description: When you are knocked down, stunned or hit by a car.

interactions.label: Blinded
interactions.description: Flashbangs and other blinding effects.

interactions.label: Relic glitches
interactions.description: While the Relic acts up and Johnny breaks through.

interactions.label: Being hacked
interactions.description: While an enemy netrunner uploads a quickhack into you. Builds as the upload completes.

interactions.label: Sandevistan & Kerenzikov
interactions.description: While time is slowed.

interactions.label: Berserk
interactions.description: While Berserk is active. Climbs the longer it runs.

interactions.label: Quickhack upload
interactions.description: While one of your quickhacks is uploading.

interactions.label: Optical camo
interactions.description: While you are cloaked.

interactions.label: Sprinting
interactions.description: A footstep rhythm while you sprint.

interactions.label: Jumps
interactions.description: Jumps, double jumps and charge jumps.

interactions.label: Landings
interactions.description: Harder landings hit harder; a superhero landing hits hardest.

interactions.label: Dodges & slides
interactions.description: Dodges, air dashes and slides.

interactions.label: Climbs & vaults
interactions.description: Pulling yourself up a ledge or vaulting over cover.

interactions.label: Out of stamina
interactions.description: When your stamina runs dry.

interactions.label: Running out of air
interactions.description: Diving with less than half your air left. Gets stronger as it runs out.

interactions.label: Engine
interactions.description: Idles low in any vehicle and follows the revs and your speed.

interactions.label: Crashes
interactions.description: Collisions while you are in a vehicle.

interactions.label: Drifting
interactions.description: Handbrake turns and sliding tires.

interactions.label: Gear shifts
interactions.description: A click on every gear change.

interactions.label: Police heat
interactions.description: Each time your wanted level goes up.

interactions.label: Level up
interactions.description: Character level, Street Cred and skill level-ups.

interactions.label: Quest completed
interactions.description: When a job or quest is marked complete.

interactions.label: Eddies received
interactions.description: Getting paid. Bigger payouts are stronger.

interactions.label: Healing
interactions.description: Using a MaxDoc, Bounce Back or other healing item.

interactions.label: Loot pickups
interactions.description: Each item you pick up.

interactions.label: Incoming calls
interactions.description: Rings until you answer or decline a holocall.

interactions.label: Romance scenes
interactions.description: Judy, Kerry, Panam, River and Meredith Stout, each following its own scene's timing.

interactions.label: Joytoys
interactions.description: Jig-Jig Street and Heywood, synced to each clip with a pattern inspired by the game's rumble rhythm.

interactions.label: Braindances
interactions.description: While you are inside a braindance.

interactions.label: Other mods
interactions.description: Pulses sent by other CET mods through GetMod("nightCityHaptics").Pulse(strength, seconds).

tracks._about: Scene timelines in seconds from each scene's anchor; cues are short pulses on top. Derived from vanilla scene files.
